listings.title: 1966 Stone-and-Cypress Bridge House Spanning a Mountain Stream
listings.editorialNote: A sub-$250k mid-century miracle 90 minutes from DC: listen to a cold mountain creek rush directly beneath the living room beams.

listings.title: 1874 Gothic Revival Stone Chapel Converted Into Painter's Loft
listings.editorialNote: A deconsecrated 1874 limestone chapel where the bell tower is now a vertical reading library. Priced at $238/sqft after a steep autumn cut.

listings.title: 1895 One-Room Timber Schoolhouse With Original Belfry & Woodstove
listings.editorialNote: A rare sub-$200k Catskills find: original wide-plank chestnut floors, towering sash windows, and an acoustic vaulted hall converted into a live-work studio on nearly 2 meadow acres.

listings.title: 1896 Double-Gallery Creole Townhouse With Tropical Plunge Courtyard
listings.editorialNote: Just returned to market with a $104k reduction. Restored bargeboard walls, louvered shutters, and a hidden saltwater plunge pool beneath century-old banana trees.

listings.title: 1882 Second Empire Mansard Brick Mansion Overlooking Galena River
listings.editorialNote: Under $250k for 3,140 sq ft of museum-grade 1882 brick masonry with intact walnut staircases and marble hearths. Needs cosmetic plaster work but structurally rock-solid.

listings.title: 1927 George Washington Smith-Era Adobe Villa With Citrus Courtyard
listings.editorialNote: Riviera-edge Spanish Colonial Revival with intact Malibu tile risers and ocean-glimpse loggia—$250k under initial list.

listings.title: Minimalist Rammed-Earth Compound & Sculpture Courtyard
listings.editorialNote: A Donald Judd-era sensibility rendered in monolithic desert adobe with a detached 600 sq ft gallery studio. Priced $84/sqft below the Marfa zip median after an abrupt relocation price cut.

listings.title: 1894 Cream City Brick Corner Tavern Converted to Sculptor's Residence
listings.editorialNote: Live-work Riverwest icon retaining its carved corner bar and pressed-tin ceilings for $119/sqft.

listings.title: Acoustic Cedar Recording Studio & Residence on 5 Wooded Acres
listings.editorialNote: Built for a Grammy-winning producer: a full floated acoustic live room seamlessly connected to a sunlit timber residence—listed today $120k under prior appraisal.

listings.title: 1955 MiMo Concrete-Brise-Soleil Villa in Upper Eastside
listings.editorialNote: Submitted via community watchlist: classic Miami Modern (MiMo) silhouette with sculptural sunscreens and untouched terrazzo—priced 34% below MiMo median $/sqft.

listings.title: 1968 Exposed-Steel Cantilevered Hillside Home Overlooking Three Rivers
listings.editorialNote: Engineered by a Bethlehem Steel metallurgist with dramatic glass walls suspended above the Monongahela. Unbeatable value at $141/sqft.

listings.title: Hand-Milled Old-Growth Redwood Sanctuary Overlooking Pacific Fog Line
listings.editorialNote: Sculpted from salvaged storm-felled redwood by a local boatbuilder in 1974. At $799/sqft it trades 31% under Big Sur's median after a $340k winter reduction.

listings.title: 1879 Italianate Brick Carriage & Malt Loft With Private Roof Terrace
listings.editorialNote: Former 19th-century brewery malt annex with a stone barrel-vault cellar beneath the kitchen—freshly reduced to $149/sqft in Over-the-Rhine.

listings.title: 1860 Timber-Frame Hay Barn Reborn as Minimalist Art Sanctuary
listings.editorialNote: Listed this morning: an 1860 post-and-beam hay barn transformed with museum-grade lighting, radiant concrete floors, and a spring-fed swimming pond.

listings.title: 1911 Sonoran Mud-Adobe Rowhouse With Saguaro Courtyard & Plunge
listings.editorialNote: Barrio Viejo icon with turquoise timber lintels, saguaro-rib ceilings, and an intimate tiled courtyard plunge pool—fresh to market under $400k.

listings.title: 1934 Fieldstone Watchtower Cottage Overlooking Shenandoah Valley
listings.editorialNote: Built by Depression-era stonemasons with a circular two-story turret library facing Shenandoah National Park—cut $54k this week.

listings.title: Weathered-Cedar Courtyard Compound Tucked in Chilmark Stone Walls
listings.editorialNote: Quietly understated Vineyard architecture in silvered cedar shingles—priced $295k below original ask with coveted Chilmark beach rights.

listings.title: Hand-Plastered Adobe Compound Facing Georgia O'Keeffe Cliffs
listings.editorialNote: True mud-brick adobe with sculpted kiva fireplaces and four unfenced acres of painted-desert canyon views for $170/sqft.

listings.title: 1888 Victorian Ore-Assay Brick Estate With Glass Conservatory Addition
listings.editorialNote: A rare West End Aspen landmark pairing an 1888 silver-boom brick cottage with a razor-sharp glass dining wing—listed at $1,275/sqft in a $2,150/sqft market.

listings.title: Corrugated Corten & Glass Desert Observatory Surrounded by Boulders
listings.editorialNote: Five private acres of giant boulders with a motorized stargazing roof hatch over the primary bed. Priced $84/sqft under the Joshua Tree median.

listings.title: 1892 Brick Coach House Turned Minimalist Glass-Courtyard Loft
listings.editorialNote: Tucked off historic Benefit Street: a 19th-century brick carriage house opened up with blackened steel glazing and a private bamboo courtyard.

listings.title: 1908 Dade County Pine Conch House With Lush Saltwater Lagoon
listings.editorialNote: Authentic Old Town wood-frame conch cottage with original vaulted timber ceilings and a private tropical plunge pool—cut $155k below comps.

listings.title: 1976 Monolithic Concrete Geodesic Dome Nestled in Red Rock Canyon
listings.editorialNote: A Buckminster Fuller dream anchored directly against red sandstone cliffs. The acoustic central dome and $110k price reduction make it an instant standout.

listings.title: Glulam Timber & Basalt Ridge House Facing the Grand Teton
listings.editorialNote: Monumental glulam beams frame a dead-center view of the Grand Teton. At $696/sqft, it is one of the sharpest architectural values in Jackson Hole.

listings.title: 1906 Converted Brick Firehouse With Brass Pole & 16-Foot Garage Bay
listings.editorialNote: Engine Co. 104 preserved with its glazed brick walls, arched apparatus doors, and original brass pole—currently priced at $244/sqft in a $415/sqft Logan Square/Bucktown corridor.

listings.title: 1971 Post-and-Beam Glass Pavilion Above Point Dume Cove
listings.editorialNote: Rare architectural time-capsule on Point Dume with deeded private cove access. Just reduced half a million dollars to $1,317/sqft.

listings.title: 1836 Charleston Single House With Double Piazzas & Kitchen House
listings.editorialNote: South of Broad pedigree at $410/sqft—including a separate two-story brick dependency ideal for a guest studio or rental income.

listings.title: 1848 Converted Grist Mill With Functioning Millrace & Bridge
listings.editorialNote: Fresh to market this morning: three stories of hand-cut Vermont fieldstone straddling a trout creek. Massive 18-inch hemlock joists and an intact lower stone wheelhouse ready for a plunge spa.

listings.title: 1969 Lake Michigan Dune A-Frame With Private Cedar Boardwalk
listings.editorialNote: Tucked behind Lake Michigan sand dunes with a cherry-red 1969 Malm cone fireplace intact. Priced under $300k after a seller relocation cut.

listings.title: 1876 Painted-Brick Second Empire Townhouse Facing Lafayette Park
listings.editorialNote: Soaring 13-foot parlor ceilings, gilded pier mirrors, and a brick rear carriage house for $135/sqft overlooking America's oldest urban park west of the Mississippi.

listings.title: 1884 Brick Carriage House Hidden Behind Walled Wisteria Courtyard
listings.editorialNote: Rare standalone brick carriage house in the Historic District—no HOA, private cobblestone courtyard, and a recent $86k price drop taking it 26% below zip median $/sqft.

listings.title: Limestone & Blackened-Steel Pavilion Overlooking Barton Creek Greenbelt
listings.editorialNote: In the heart of 78704, this architect-owned steel pavilion opens directly onto limestone creek cliffs—just slashed $180k to $397/sqft.

listings.title: Cedar & Concrete Waterfront Pavilion on Orcas Island Cove
listings.editorialNote: Watch orcas pass from a cantilevered cedar terrace on Deer Harbor—just dropped $235k to $593/sqft.

listings.title: Blackened-Cedar & Cast-Concrete Vineyard Pavilion in Calistoga
listings.editorialNote: A dramatic blackened-timber modern barn framed by 100-year-old olive trees and a producing Cabernet block, freshly trimmed by $345k.

listings.title: Board-Formed Concrete Alpine Monolith With Geothermal Plunge
listings.editorialNote: Carved into a sagebrush ridge facing the Sneffels Range. Board-formed concrete meets white oak joinery—just repriced $185k down for a winter closing.

listings.title: Off-Grid Solar Atrium Earthship With Indoor Banana Greenhouse
listings.editorialNote: A sculptural high-desert sanctuary that grows citrus indoors year-round at 7,000 feet elevation. Completely off-grid with upgraded LiFePO4 battery bank and 360-degree Sangre de Cristo views.

listings.title: Off-Grid Glass & Corrugated-Steel Ski Cabin in the Sawtooths
listings.editorialNote: Zero neighbors across nearly 5 alpine acres with direct backcountry ski access and panoramic views of the jagged Sawtooth crest.

listings.title: 1957 Usonian-Inspired Brick & Redwood Courtyard House
listings.editorialNote: Time-capsule 1957 Usonian gem overlooking creek parkland. Original built-in redwood credenzas and radiant heated floors at $227/sqft—a full 27% below local comps.

listings.title: Cantilevered Steel & Glass Pavilion Over a Private Waterfall
listings.editorialNote: Built in 1972 by a Mies van der Rohe acolyte, this steel-and-glass box floats 28 feet above a seasonal granite gorge. Just cut by $210k—bringing it well under Garrison's median price per square foot.

listings.title: Sandstone-Tinted Concrete Desert House Framed by La Sal Mountains
listings.editorialNote: Cast in iron-oxide concrete matching the surrounding red sandstone mesas, with zero light pollution and an $94k price cut.

listings.title: 1959 Harvard Five Glass-Walled Modernist Pavilion on 2.4 Woodland Acres
listings.editorialNote: Museum-pedigree 1959 New Canaan modernism with restored mahogany wall panels, floating bluestone hearth, and serene pond views.

listings.title: Scandinavian Black-Timber Bluff House Above Lake Michigan
listings.editorialNote: Crisp Nordic minimalism perched on a limestone Door County bluff—complete with a cedar sauna house and $70k off-season price cut.

listings.title: Weathered-Steel & Douglas Fir Ranch Compound on Gallatin Creek
listings.editorialNote: A Bridger Canyon modern compound with 600 feet of trout-filled creek frontage and a detached timber guest bunkhouse.

listings.title: Architectural Cedar Floating Home on Lake Union With Rooftop Deck
listings.editorialNote: Submitted via open-source watchlist PR: owned slip floating home with cedar millwork and unobstructed Space Needle sunset views—listed $138/sqft below Eastlake's median.

listings.title: 1964 Circular Space-Age Hillside Villa With Sunken Conversation Pit
listings.editorialNote: Pure 1964 sci-fi optimism: a flying-saucer roof canopy wrapping a central terrazzo conversation pit with unobstructed San Jacinto mountain views. Untouched by flippers.

listings.title: Cedar-Clad Cliffside A-Frame Perched Above Sitka Spruce Forest
listings.editorialNote: Hit the MLS 14 hours ago. A razor-sharp 1978 timber A-frame restored with Shou Sugi Ban siding and an outdoor hinoki soaking tub tucked into coastal mist.

listings.title: 1891 Coastal Keeper's Quarters & Watchtower on 2.8 Tidal Acres
listings.editorialNote: Listed 48 hours ago after 42 years in one family. The octagonal glass watchtower surveys Penobscot Bay, paired with a deepwater mooring and working granite boathouse.
